title: Overwriting the next buffer cell
statement: For Boolean lists $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{old}$ and a Boolean $b$, let the buffer tape store their concatenation. Replacing the tape content at the integer cell $|\mathrm{pre}|$ by $b$ gives the buffer tape storing $\mathrm{pre}$ followed by $b$ and then by $\mathrm{old}$ with its first symbol dropped.
replaced:
Writing a bit at position $|\mathit{pre}|$ of the buffer tape holding
$\mathit{pre} \mathbin{+\!\!+} \mathit{old}$ yields the buffer tape holding
$\mathit{pre}$, then that bit, then the tail of $\mathit{old}$ with its first
cell dropped; this includes the case of an empty $\mathit{old}$.
